title: Create a disk image backup
summary: Create a complete backup of a disk or partition into an IMG file. This file can be used to restore the disk later.
prerequisites: Sufficient free space on the destination drive for the backup file
Knowledge of the source disk device identifier

steps.explain: Create a backup image of a disk. Replace <SOURCE_DRIVE> with the device identifier (e.g., /dev/disk2) and <OUTPUT_FILE> with the path for the .img file.

placeholders.name: SOURCE_DRIVE
placeholders.description: Device identifier of the disk to backup

steps.expect: Progress information is displayed as the backup is created.

warnings: Ensure the destination has enough space for the entire disk image.
The backup file can be very large.

rollback.explain: There is no undo command on this page for the backup file itself. To remove the backup, delete the file manually via Finder or Terminal.
